plan.objective: maximize training net profit after costs; drawdown and sample constraints unchanged
plan.feature: EMA20 rise over 3 closed H4 bars / mean true range of last 14 closed H4 bars, fixed 80-bar EMA initialization
plan.fit_rule: nonnegative Q25/Q50 from all training baseline BUY entries; at least 20 feature observations; no outcome labels in quantile fitting
plan.select_rule: highest total net among positive/improved total net, positive BUY net, >=20 retained BUY trades, DD<=1.25 baseline; otherwise off
plan.promotion_gates: filter selected in >=1 fold; improved aggregate and positive/improved confirmation net; >=20 confirmation trades; aggregate/confirmation DD<=1.25 baseline; positive/not-worse stress confirmation
plan.engine_alignment: Entry-bias EMA now uses the same configured count of closed bars in live and replay (previously live included a forming bar in its count while replay used an arbitrary 120-bar minimum). Both models are rerun with this alignment.
caveats: These historical dates were previously examined; this is not untouched future validation.
Training windows overlap; their sums are not independent observations or portfolio returns.
SELL rules are unchanged, but realized SELL opportunities can differ when fewer long positions occupy capacity.
Commission/slippage are unverified assumptions; no swap, latency or full tick reconstruction.
